---
title: "Installing Metis"
---

Metis is implemented in Python and its dependencies are manged with [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/). While you can install Metis without uv, this is **not recommended**.

## Installation with uv

Before you begin install uv and git as system packages on your operating system. Then,

1. Clone the Metis repository via 
    
    ```bash
    git clone ...
    ```
2. Change directory
    
    ```bash
    cd ...
    ```
3. Use uv to install the correct version of Python and all of the required dependencies

    ```bash
    uv sync
    ```
::: {.callout-tip}
 If you would like to contribue to the development of Metis (or just run the test suite), use
```bash
    uv sync --dev
```
and then
```bash
uv run pytest -v
```
to run the full test suite.
:::
